prompts: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE breathtaking, finished portrait LinkedIn poster, 4:5 aspect ratio, high resolution, for Anthony Apollis's actual Cape Town Housing Opportunity Atlas portfolio. Art direction: premium architectural editorial, elegant warm ivory typography on midnight forest green, a dramatic miniature Cape Town-inspired city and unmistakable flat-topped Table Mountain cut from sculptural layers of translucent topographic paper. Golden early light grazes fine buildings, Atlantic water luminous teal, a few delicate amber analytical paths. A sophisticated magazine cover with huge clean typography and disciplined negative space, no stock-photo corporate aesthetic. The city is a conceptual editorial illustration, not an accurate cadastral map. Do not depict approved new housing. Keep every word highly legible on a phone, clear margins, no tiny dense blocks. Exact text only: top small "ANTHONY APOLLIS / PORTFOLIO"; dominant headline "CAPE TOWN." then "A CLOSER LOOK."; subhead "30 precincts. 14 criteria. Better questions."; short skills line "PYTHON  /  GIS  /  POWER BI"; bottom call to action "AVAILABLE FOR REMOTE ROLES + CONTRACT PROJECTS"; web address "capetownhousing.netlify.app"; small but readable footer "Concept illustration · Desktop screening study". No logos, QR codes, extra numbers, fake charts, signatures or invented awards.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE extraordinary finished portrait 4:5 LinkedIn campaign poster for Anthony Apollis. Premium museum-exhibition graphic design meets dimensional information art. Warm ivory background, exceptionally crisp dark forest-green typography, deep teal and brushed brass accents. Centre: a sculptural exploded stack of three wafer-thin glass and paper layers hovering above a subtle Cape Town-inspired relief. Bottom layer abstract data columns; middle layer geospatial routes and point markers; top layer an elegant open report with abstract tiny unreadable lines (no fabricated metrics). Precise shadows, tactile print textures, dynamic diagonal perspective, restrained luxury. Use generous white space and strong type hierarchy. This is a conceptual illustration of a data workflow, never pretend it is a real product screenshot. Exact clearly legible text: small top "ANTHONY APOLLIS"; huge headline "FROM DATA" then "TO DECISIONS."; subhead "Analysis. Maps. Models. Clear reporting."; lower skills lines "Python + GIS" and "Power BI semantic modelling + DAX"; footer emphasis "OPEN TO REMOTE ROLES + FREELANCE PROJECTS"; link "capetownhousing.netlify.app"; tiny readable caption "Concept illustration / Portfolio project". No additional words, corporate logos, invented code, awards, certificates, promises or bogus KPIs.

Use case: ads-marketing. Make ONE breathtaking professional portrait LinkedIn poster, 4:5 aspect ratio, with impeccable typography for Anthony Apollis's remote-work availability. High-end editorial photograph-like conceptual render of a magnificent Table Mountain silhouette across a moonlit blue-green ocean, fine warm city lights below, subtle concentric contour lines fading into the night sky. A luminous thin arc across the horizon suggests global collaboration, no globe, no flags, no sci-fi clutter. Vast refined dark negative space for beautifully set warm-ivory type. Composition calm, ambitious, distinctly Cape Town. Use a sharp serif headline paired with clean sans-serif details. Exact text, all highly legible: top "ANTHONY APOLLIS"; huge main headline "LOCAL INSIGHT." then "GLOBAL REACH."; subhead "Data analytics · GIS · BI modelling"; prominent availability block "AVAILABLE FOR REMOTE ROLES" and "Freelance + contract projects"; call to action "Explore my work. Let’s talk."; web address "capetownhousing.netlify.app"; small footer "AI-generated editorial illustration". Do not invent a portrait of Anthony, job history, employer, years of experience, endorsements or service guarantees. No extra text, logos, QR codes or watermarks.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create one premium landscape LinkedIn article cover, very wide 2:1 aspect ratio, high resolution. It belongs to a coordinated Anthony Apollis Cape Town analytics campaign: forest green, warm ivory, muted gold, tactile architectural relief and exceptional editorial typography. Left half: clean deep forest-green negative space with exact large ivory serif headline "A CITY." then "A DATA STORY." and smaller sans-serif byline "Anthony Apollis". Right half: a spectacular cinematic Cape Town-inspired miniature terrain of Table Mountain, a teal coast, a few warm golden point markers and fine connecting lines, realistic carved-paper textures and afternoon side-light. A subtle topographic grid dissolves into the dark background. It must feel like a world-class magazine feature rather than a software advertisement. Keep all text inside a generous central safe area so cropping leaves it intact. Exact small footer: "Cape Town Housing Opportunity Atlas" and "Concept illustration". No other text, no logos, no invented data values, no fabricated software screens, no QR codes. This is an AI editorial interpretation, not satellite evidence or a parcel map.
